# discord_channel (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild channel. Requires the bot to have `MANAGE_CHANNELS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_channel" "announcements" {
  guild_id = "123456789012345678"
  name     = "announcements"
  type     = 0 # GUILD_TEXT
  topic    = "Server news and updates"
  nsfw     = false
}

resource "discord_channel" "voice_lounge" {
  guild_id   = "123456789012345678"
  name       = "Lounge"
  type       = 2 # GUILD_VOICE
  bitrate    = 64000
  user_limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild. Changing this forces a new channel.
- `name` (String) Channel name (1-100 characters).
- `type` (Number) Discord channel type (0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 5 announcement, 13 stage, 15 forum). Changing this forces a new channel.

### Optional

- `bitrate` (Number) Voice channel bitrate in bits per second.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is NSFW.
- `parent_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the parent category channel.
- `position` (Number) Sorting position of the channel.
- `rate_limit_per_user` (Number) Slowmode: seconds a user must wait between messages (0-21600).
- `topic` (String) Channel topic (0-1024 characters).
- `user_limit` (Number) Voice channel user limit (0 means no limit).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Channels are imported using their channel snowflake ID.
terraform import discord_channel.announcements 987654321098765432
```
